fix: isolate degraded Codex capabilities

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-62
  description: |-
    Fail Codex capability preparation when optional filesystem capabilities remain provider-discoverable but cannot be sealed, and revalidate sealed optional Plugin and Skill content before dispatch.
    
    Force an invocation-scoped Codex App Server with an explicit MCP table whenever the sealed manifest contains MCP authority, including when every optional server degrades away.
